transformRef.description: Identifier resolved against `migrations.TransformRegistry` to look up the actual transform callable (v0.22.0+, FP-4). Without this, the migration contract is documentation-only — humans read the transformSteps and apply changes by hand. With it, `MigrationRunner` can execute the transform end-to-end.

lossyOk.description: When false (default), the runner refuses to apply a contract whose `lossyFields` is non-empty. When true, the caller has explicitly acknowledged that fields will be dropped — equivalent to a `_weakens_criteria` override in scope.
